fields.description: Mudon Al Ranim 5 is a townhouse release within Mudon in Dubailand. Its three- and four-bedroom homes include layouts with an additional family room, set alongside landscaped community spaces. This profile separates the original Phase 5 plans and commercial calendar from current availability and completion checks.

overview: Phase 5 is one release within the wider Mudon neighbourhood. The named layout should be matched to the plot and sale agreement before using a published area, room arrangement or commercial schedule.
research.locationNote: Mudon, Dubailand, Dubai. Exact plot position, access and outlook require unit-specific confirmation.
research.priceNote: The official Phase 5 sheet lists AED 2.28m for three bedrooms and AED 2.75m for four bedrooms. The current own page retains different AED 2.06m text while its navigation marks the release sold out. Property Finder showed AED 3.3m as its lowest available listing reference when opened, with a search snapshot previously showing AED 3.1m. These are different dated bases, not a verified current developer offer or Aliyas stock.
research.paymentNote: The original Phase 5 schedule is 10% booking, 50% across construction instalments and 40% on its July 2026 handover target. All displayed dates are historical terms from that sheet. A resale, assignment or new offer needs its own outstanding-balance statement and payment agreement; Phase 7 calendars are not substituted.
research.handoverNote: The original official sheet estimated July 2026. Property Finder now labels the project Ready but retains September 2026 and under-development narrative. Dubai Properties’ latest retrieved update is Q1 2026: its internal inspection on 10 March recorded 96.13%, while a 31 January RERA inspection recorded 85.26%. Building completion certificates were obtained for all units, but approvals, final works, commissioning and snagging were still described as pending. No later unit handover evidence was retrieved; the headline date remains unset.

facts.label: Dated construction snapshot
facts.value: Q1 2026: building works 96.44% and infrastructure 90%. Internal overall 96.13% on 10 March 2026 and RERA 85.26% on 31 January 2026 use different inspection dates; neither is a current October measurement.

unresolved: Actual handover, live availability, current asking price, outstanding instalments and transfer eligibility require selected-unit confirmation; sold-out developer marketing does not prove resale inventory.

Published plan figures are total areas. Plot sizes, service charges, cooling arrangements, finishes and as-built dimensions were not established for an individual home. Plans and renders are illustrative and subject to change.
4B2’s left Arabic panel prints 276.15 sq m; its English and mirrored panels print 279.15 sq m (3,004.77 sq ft). Confirm the contractual area.
The retained AED 2.06m own-page text, original phase-specific launch tiers, changing portal references and Ready/under-development status language cannot be treated as one consistent current offer.
